title: initial_oas — specification skeleton (produced by Stage 2; decision record 000 §2.3, D4, D5)
description: Specification skeleton recovered from session-bundle traffic. A standard OpenAPI 3.1 document (full OAS validity is checked by the vendored official meta-schema, approved supplementary choice point 2); the metadata envelope lives in x-carverflow-meta (approved supplementary choice point 1); every operation has an operationId derived deterministically per D5.

paths.description: Keys are canonical paths (parameterized template paths obtained by clustering and normalizing literal URLs, e.g. /articles/{slug})

operationId.description: Deterministic derivation per D5: {method}_{normalized canonical_path} (e.g. GET /articles/{slug} → get_articles_slug). All artifacts reference each other by operationId.

x-carverflow-observations.description: Join result (approved addition in decision record 003 §6/D20/D22): all raw observations of this operation. Every operation has at least one observation (initial_oas is recovered from observations). The declared consumption channel for Stage 2.5 (anchor scheduling) and Stage 4 (UI temporal / value-flow evidence); literal examples for templates are traced back through it.

observation.description: One API observation: source session bundle + har entry reference + action attribution (or orphan class; mutually exclusive).

run_id.description: run_id of the source session bundle (D20 reference shape)

entry_index.description: Entry index in har log.entries (D20 reference shape)

action_id.description: ID of the ui_action the observation is attributed to (mutually exclusive with orphan_class, D22)

orphan_class.description: Orphan class (mutually exclusive with action_id; D22 executable boundary rule)

confidence_tier.description: Confidence tier of the action attribution (D22: strict hit within the interval / tail); absent for orphan observations

status.description: Observed response status (including 4xx/5xx; D21 is independent of the status; 0 = no response observed / load failure)

auth_present.description: Whether the request carried an authentication header (D24: authentication does not enter the parameters table; its presence is recorded on the observation)
